subject: Session updates in csv lost when app restarts

messages.author: 828de4897957eddc
messages.subject: Session updates in csv lost when app restarts
parts:
I have a shiny app which allows the user to update a csv file and saves the same .. This file is part of the resources while deploying the app and the command that I use is write.table

The write is successful and the app does the desired actions in the ongoing session. Even parallel sessions at that time sees the updated data

The issue I face is when the app restarts (either following a timeout or when manually refreshed in shiny), this update gets lost and the csv filereturns back to the version which was at the time of deployment...

Why is this happening and how to overcome ?

Rgards,

Shami
